articles.title: GHSA: Payload: Unauthorized update to collection documents
articles.summary:
## Impact

An attacker can submit a request to a specific endpoint that permits collection documents to be updated regardless of access control and field level access control.

**You are affected if:**

- You are configuring `orderable: true` with any collection or join field.

articles.title: GHSA: Ghost: Stored XSS via oEmbed Photo Responses
articles.summary:
### Impact

Embedding a URL from an attacker-controlled website could result in untrusted scripts being stored in post content. These scripts could run in the Ghost editor, on the published site, and in newsletter emails, possibly resulting in compromise of a staff user's admin session.

### Vulnerable versions

This vulnerability is present in Ghost from v2.1.0 up to v6.64.0.

### Patches

v6.64.

articles.title: GHSA: Ghost: Stored XSS via Bookmark Card Images
articles.summary:
### Impact

When creating a bookmark card, Ghost could store non-image files fetched from an external website as bookmark icons or thumbnails. This allowed any staff user, including Contributors, to host arbitrary HTML on the site's domain, possibly resulting in compromise of other staff users' admin sessions.

### Vulnerable versions

This vulnerability is present in Ghost from v5.94.0 up to v6.6

### Vulnerable versions

This vulnerability is present in Ghost from v0.7.2 up to v6.64.0.

### Patches

articles.title: GHSA: Ghost: Stored XSS via File Uploads on Local Storage
articles.summary:
### Impact

Ghost restricts the content type that uploaded files are served with, to prevent browsers from executing them. On sites using the default local storage adapter, this restriction was not applied, so files uploaded by any staff user were served with a content type derived from their file extension.
